<documents>
<document id="travel-card-abroad">
UsingˆyourˆcardˆabroadˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆworksˆinˆmostˆcountries,ˆanywhereˆVisaˆisˆaccepted.ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆgoˆ-ˆKeepˆnotificationsˆonˆforˆtheˆappˆsoˆyouˆcanˆanswerˆfraudˆalertsˆquickly.ˆ-ˆMakeˆsureˆInternationalˆpurchasesˆisˆswitchedˆonˆunderˆCards,ˆthenˆControls.ˆ-ˆCheckˆyourˆplan'sˆforeignˆtransactionˆandˆinternationalˆATMˆfees.ˆ-ˆAddˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆtoˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆasˆaˆbackup.ˆ##ˆWhatˆitˆcostsˆPurchasesˆinˆaˆforeignˆcurrencyˆcarryˆaˆforeignˆtransactionˆfeeˆofˆ3%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ1%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ0%ˆonˆPremium.ˆATMˆwithdrawalsˆabroadˆhaveˆtheirˆownˆinternationalˆATMˆfeeˆinstead.ˆ##ˆPayingˆinˆtheˆlocalˆcurrencyˆWhenˆaˆcardˆterminalˆasksˆwhetherˆtoˆpayˆinˆUSˆdollarsˆorˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency,ˆchooseˆtheˆlocalˆcurrency.ˆ##ˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆabroadˆFreezeˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆreportˆit.ˆStandardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆonlyˆgoˆtoˆUSˆaddresses.ˆPremiumˆmembersˆcanˆgetˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆdeliveredˆabroad.ˆEveryoneˆelseˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwithˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆaˆmobileˆwallet.ˆDoˆyouˆneedˆtoˆtellˆusˆyou'reˆtraveling?ˆNo.ˆSeeˆ"DoˆIˆneedˆaˆtravelˆnotice?".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="transfers-pending">
Whyˆisˆmyˆtransferˆpending?ˆAˆtransferˆcanˆshowˆasˆpendingˆforˆaˆfewˆreasons.ˆHere'sˆhowˆtoˆtellˆwhat'sˆgoingˆon.ˆ##ˆWaitingˆforˆtheˆcutoffˆACHˆtransfersˆsubmittedˆafterˆ4:00ˆPMˆET,ˆorˆonˆaˆweekendˆorˆholiday,ˆstayˆpendingˆuntilˆthey'reˆsentˆonˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆOnˆitsˆwayˆOnceˆsent,ˆACHˆtransfersˆtakeˆ1ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆtoˆarrive.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdateˆonˆtheˆtransfer.ˆ##ˆUnderˆreviewˆSomeˆtransfersˆareˆreviewedˆbeforeˆthey'reˆsent,ˆforˆexampleˆaˆlargeˆfirstˆtransferˆtoˆaˆnewlyˆlinkedˆaccount.ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆ"Inˆreview".ˆReviewsˆusuallyˆfinishˆwithinˆoneˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆwe'llˆmessageˆyouˆifˆweˆneedˆanything.ˆ##ˆNewˆdeviceˆForˆ24ˆhoursˆafterˆyouˆsignˆinˆonˆaˆnewˆdevice,ˆtransfersˆaboveˆ$500ˆcan'tˆbeˆsent.ˆ##ˆIncomingˆtransfersˆIfˆmoneyˆsentˆtoˆyouˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆcheckˆwithˆtheˆsender'sˆbankˆwhenˆitˆwasˆsent.ˆDirectˆdepositsˆusuallyˆarriveˆasˆsoonˆasˆyourˆemployer'sˆpaymentˆfileˆreachesˆus.ˆIfˆaˆtransferˆhasˆbeenˆpendingˆlongerˆthanˆtheˆexpectedˆarrivalˆdate,ˆmessageˆsupportˆwithˆtheˆamountˆandˆdate.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="cushion-plus">
CushionˆonˆPlusˆOnˆPlus,ˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆupˆtoˆ$50.00ˆbelowˆzero,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆTurningˆitˆonˆGoˆtoˆProfile,ˆthenˆCushion.ˆYouˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆIfˆyouˆstopˆmeetingˆthat,ˆCushionˆpausesˆuntilˆyouˆdoˆagain.ˆ##ˆExampleˆIfˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆlowˆandˆyouˆbuyˆgroceriesˆthatˆcostˆmoreˆthanˆyouˆhave,ˆCushionˆcoversˆtheˆdifferenceˆasˆlongˆasˆtheˆtotalˆbelowˆzeroˆstaysˆwithinˆ$50.00.ˆAˆpurchaseˆthatˆwouldˆtakeˆyouˆpastˆ$50.00ˆbelowˆzeroˆisˆdeclined.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆCushionˆcoversˆdebitˆcardˆpurchasesˆonly.ˆItˆneverˆcoversˆATMˆwithdrawals,ˆtransfersˆorˆwires.ˆ##ˆRepayingˆYourˆnextˆdepositˆrepaysˆit.ˆIfˆyouˆstayˆnegativeˆforˆ30ˆdays,ˆCushionˆisˆsuspended.ˆIfˆtheˆbalanceˆisˆstillˆnegativeˆafterˆ60ˆdays,ˆtheˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆuntilˆit'sˆrepaid.ˆ##ˆCostˆCushionˆhasˆnoˆfeesˆandˆnoˆinterestˆ($0.00).ˆItˆisn'tˆaˆloanˆandˆisn'tˆreportedˆtoˆcreditˆbureaus.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
